newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey, Gazprom sign $13.5 billion natural gas deal.
newsitem.headline: Turkey, Gazprom sign $13.5 billion natural gas deal.

text.p: Turkey signed a $13.5 billion agreement with Russian gas giant Gazprom on Monday under which it will eventually receive five times as much Russian natural gas as it gets now.

"The total value of the project is about $13.5 billion and it is a 25-year agreement starting from this year," Mustafa Murathan, head of Turkey's state pipeline concern Botas, told reporters after signing the deal with Gazprom head Rem Vyahirev in Istanbul.

Vyahirev said the deal would enable Turkey, which currently imports six billion cubic meters of Russian gas annually, to tap Russian gas at gradually increasing amounts that will reach 30 billion cubic meters by 2010.
